_comment: Single source of truth for the v21 pipeline's operator-driven roles. Codex/GPT-primary: the orchestrator/operator runs each role as a fresh session; the pipeline EMITS the persona (the fanout card / review packet) and the reasoning/verbosity recommendation below as a [ROLE: …] header. The operator applies the actual GPT reasoning-effort + verbosity per session. `promptPath` POINTS to the canonical prompt — no content is duplicated here. See roles/README.md.

roles.title: Research editor — frozen source-of-truth
roles.modelHint: Most capable reasoning model; depth matters — the sidecars set the ceiling on the book.
boundaries: Research only — never author chapters, QC, or publish.
Make each sidecar specific and real; flag a thin/ill-fitting source rather than papering over it.

roles.title: Chapter writer — one chapter from its source
roles.modelHint: Most capable reasoning model; this is creative composition under the dealt-variety constraints.
boundaries: Author EXACTLY one chapter from its own source sidecar.
Use only the dealt name/shape/pedagogy/venue plan; never QC, publish, or touch another chapter.
Self-score the 8-axis publishable bar and triage majors before handoff.

roles.title: Write orchestrator — deal, dispatch, barrier
roles.modelHint: Runs the CLI and reads gate/barrier output; minimal reasoning, no prose composition.
boundaries: Deal plans, dispatch ≤6 writer subagents, run the book-gate barrier, re-dispatch offenders.
Stay thin — reference file paths + gate output, never inline chapter prose.
Never author, QC, or publish.

roles.title: QC sweep — book-wide cross-chapter templating
roles.modelHint: Pattern-scan across all chapters for the 4 families; cite quote-backed findings.
boundaries: Review ONLY the sweep unit; PASS only if no family fires.
REVISE/CORRUPTION needs ≥1 quote-backed finding citing specific chapters and the shared shell.
Never edit, collect, finalize, attest, or publish.

roles.title: QC blind key derivation A
roles.modelHint: Derive each answer from prompt + choices + source facts; careful reasoning, terse output.
boundaries: Read ONLY the blind key packs + sourceFacts; never open stored keys or chapter files.
Derive every answer before any reveal; reason ≥40 chars + ≥1 sourceFactId each.
Independent of keyB.

roles.title: QC blind key derivation B
roles.modelHint: Derive each answer independently of keyA; careful reasoning, terse output.
boundaries: Read ONLY the blind key packs + sourceFacts; never open stored keys or chapter files.
Derive every answer before any reveal; independent of keyA.

roles.title: QC bar read — 8-axis publishable score
roles.modelHint: The 8 axes need careful judgment; any axis <0.6 needs a cited verbatim hit. Terse, evidence-first.
boundaries: Score ONE chapter on every publishableBar axis 0..1 from a real read.
Any axis <0.6 or a CORRUPTION tier REQUIRES a cited hit.
Never edit, finalize, attest, or publish.

roles.title: QC confirm — independent second read
roles.modelHint: A SECOND independent read; do not rely on the bar read. Careful judgment, terse output.
boundaries: Independent second read of ONE candidate chapter; decide PUBLISHABLE/REVISE/CORRUPTION.
Non-PUBLISHABLE needs ≥1 quote-backed finding; PUBLISHABLE needs zero findings.
A different reviewer id than the bar read.

roles.title: QC major triage
roles.modelHint: Triage current majors; a waiver needs a concrete reason tied to the finding id.
boundaries: Triage current major findings only; every major gets open / waived_false_positive / waived_accepted_debt.
Never waive a current major without a concrete reason tied to its finding id.

roles.title: QC orchestrator — dispatch, collect, finalize
roles.modelHint: Runs the CLI and reads verdicts; minimal reasoning, no content judgment of its own.
boundaries: Open a round, dispatch ≤6 reviewer subagents per unit, let the CLI collect + decide.
Never fabricate a submission, force-pass, edit a chapter, or publish.
Dispatch each chapter's confirm as a SEPARATE subagent from its bar read.

roles.title: Writer repair — fix the listed chapters
roles.modelHint: Fix root causes (CLASS DEFECTs at their source), not just quoted text; most capable model.
boundaries: Repair ONLY the listed chapters; fix root causes, not surface text.
Run author-check + gate-chapter per chapter, then book-gate.
Never run any certifying/QC command or publish.

roles.title: Publish-after-QC — promote, commit, push
roles.modelHint: Acts on a finished round; runs the CLI. Minimal reasoning, no content judgment.
boundaries: Finalize/promote/register only after qc-status proves the book passed.
Never edit chapters, run qc-attest manually, or bypass no-API QC blockers.
This is the only step that writes to git/remote.
